title: The Last Will and Testament Affair
motive_summary: Inheritance Dispossession: The killer murdered the victim to gain sole access to the contested estate funds, ensuring they would inherit all assets.
overview_text: Upon arriving at 'Reed & Bell Bookshop', Ben Carter found Isabella Reed. The victim was slumped near an ornate side table, clearly having succumbed to trauma. A single object of interest was visible nearby: the Brass till weight, which had been used to inflict a fatal blow. The scene suggests a struggle occurred, but no signs of forced entry were immediately apparent.
